verdict.rationale: Grafana's Tempo docs explicitly state traces can be linked to correlated logs and metrics, exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces, and incident response docs describe investigating with the same metrics/logs/traces that fired an alert — directly supporting span-to-logs/metrics correlation for debugging. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the specific trace-to-log-to-metric jump UX and any noted limitations or setup complexity in community reports.
